review.shorterRoute: The original Cell.exists_primitive_domain supplies the star-convex neighborhood of the entire radial carrier. Pinned Mathlib simply-connected lifting and open-section theorems produce a sheet through each chosen fiber point. Existing open-embedding extension supplies its actual coordinate. The literal unramified chart comparison proves analytic nonsingular transition to cover charts. The existing generic covering trivialization and sheet decomposition were checked; the direct lift API is shorter for a single cell with a prescribed center lift. No original grid or plane slit construction is rebuilt.
